## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      1 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Aug 22, 2026 - Aug 22, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Veeresh G_, Aug 22, 2026, 5/5: "Google Fit is an amazing health and fitness tracking app! It helps you track daily steps, workouts, and heart points easily. It runs smoothly with zero ads, helping you stay motivated and healthy every day. ಗೂಗಲ್ ಫಿಟ್ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಫಿಟ್‌ನೆಸ್ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಗೆ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಆ್ಯಪ್! ಇದು ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳ ಎಣಿಕೆ, ವರ್ಕೌಟ್‌ಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಹಾರ್ಟ್ ಪಾಯಿಂಟ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಟ್ರ್ಯಾಕ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಯಾವುದೇ ಜಾಹೀರಾತುಗಳ ಕಿರಿಕಿರಿಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ, ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಆರೋಗ್ಯವಾಗಿರಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 5, 2026 - Aug 20, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Simon_, Aug 5, 2026, 1/5: "broken af. the entire screen keeps loading forever when the app has no internet even tho i know exactly what it should be showing me but its just UNUSABLE if it doesmt habe internet Access 24/7"
            2. _Abhiram Nair_, Aug 20, 2026, 2/5: "I use my samsung watch for logging my daily activities and via health connect data is set to sync with google fit. but none of my workouts are logged in and i got 0 heart points for every day. while sleep and other data are synced correctly. please fix this bug"
            3. _Karthik Rajamani_, Aug 19, 2026, 2/5: "From the latest update I see a bug. if I have a smart device like a smartwatch also tracking the steps and when I connect it and sync it up with my Google account then what is measured by Google fit and the watch in terms of the number of steps gets added for the same distance. It shows as double the value for the same walk. Earlier it was not adding it but taking the larger of the two values. For example if I have covered 5000 steps, Google fit counts both the inputs and shows as 10000 steps"
<!--/ir-theme-->
